sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1 , which must be performed for condensate pump every six months as 
indicated by M6 in above title block .
This pump supply hydraulic oil for steam valves.

The first draft 
initiated by Eng. Mahmoud Abou El-Fotouh Shata, tested by eng. Ali Abd El-Salam 
, 
revised by MDEPC quality control engineer Abouda El-bana , accepted by general 
director eng. Yosry Abd El-Maqsood, and approved by eng. Farouk Awad head sector 
of Talkha Power Station .

This document accepted by Eng. Samer Abd El-Gilil 
MDEPC inspection & quality control general director MPIS coordinator & certified 
by accountant Mohamed Nageb MDEPC admin . & financial prediction head sector & 
supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector

sections.text:
Safety 
Precautions

Issue 
work order Including the team work names .

Wear 
safety helmets shoes gloves , etc .

Isolate 
the circuit breaker of the pump motor .

Use 
safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area .

The pump 
must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves
Disconnect electric terminal of the pump motor .

Be sure 
pump must be completely drainage .

Tools and

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Pump In Service

items: Record pump pressure reading .
Check discharge quantity .

Check and record the vibration level 
 of the pump.

sections.text:
Pump 
out of Service

items:
Check alignment and compare it with 
 the setting value .

Inspect of tapered roller &needle 
 bearing oil and add or change it ( if it is needed)
Check flanges for oil leakage .

Check bolts fixation, then 
 re-tightens ( if it is needed ) .

Check the piston & rotor for wear or 
 damage.

Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint it ( if it is needed ) .

Inspect the end play of ball socket 
 joint in piston and shoe for wear or damage
